title: Crossy Road Hop Frames
summary: 39 hop animation frames for all 13 agents. 3 frames per agent: ground, peak, landing. The signature Crossy Road movement.
content:
Crossy Road Hop Frames

13 agents x 3 frames = 39 sprites at 128x128 transparent PNG.

Characters MOVE. This is what makes Corner feel like Crossy Road, not a static dashboard.

Frame Sequence

Frame 0: Ground

  • Neutral standing pose
  • Full shadow (opacity 0.35, scale 1.0)
  • Normal proportions (scaleX: 1.0, scaleY: 1.0)
  • Arms at slight angle (+5deg)

Frame 1: Peak

  • Character lifted 14px up
  • Body slightly stretched (scaleX: 0.95, scaleY: 1.08)
  • Shadow compressed and faded (opacity 0.2, scale 0.7)
  • Legs spread apart (+4px)
  • Arms swing back (-20deg)
  • Aura at 50% intensity (brighter at peak)

Frame 2: Landing

  • Character pushed down 2px below ground
  • Body squished wide (scaleX: 1.1, scaleY: 0.88)
  • Shadow expanded and dark (opacity 0.45, scale 1.2)
  • Legs compressed (-2px)
  • Arms swing forward (+15deg)
  • Dust particles visible (4 small circles)

Animation Timing

Ground (66ms) -> Peak (66ms) -> Landing (66ms) -> Ground
Total hop: 200ms
Easing: ease-out

Bobby should play frames: 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0 for one hop cycle. For continuous movement, loop. For idle-to-hop, start from current idle sprite, crossfade to ground frame in 100ms, then run the cycle.

Visual Differentiation

Each agent is identifiable during hop by:

  1. Signature color aura glow (strongest at peak)
  2. Head props: Bobby headphones, Mom headset, Steve glasses, Steffen round glasses, Cleo scarf, Tony ringlight halo
  3. Body color: Elmo is white (lab coat), Pixel is gray/cyan (glitchy), everyone else is dark with colored accent
  4. Eye treatment: Elon has green glowing eyes, Pixel has no pupils (solid fill)

Bobby Integration

Sprite sheet approach

// Preload all 3 frames
const hopFrames = ['ground', 'peak', 'landing'].map(
  frame => `/assets/characters/crossy-road/hop/${agentId}-hop-${frame}.png`
);

// Animate hop with frame cycling
function animateHop(agentId, direction) {
  const FRAME_DURATION = 66; // ms per frame
  let currentFrame = 0;

  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    setSprite(hopFrames[currentFrame]);
    currentFrame++;
    if (currentFrame > 2) {
      clearInterval(interval);
      // Move agent to new tile position
      moveToNextTile(agentId, direction);
      // Reset to idle or ground stance
      setSprite(hopFrames[0]);
    }
  }, FRAME_DURATION);
}

CSS alternative (smoother)

@keyframes hop-cycle {
  0% { content: url('ground.png'); transform: translateY(0); }
  33% { content: url('peak.png'); transform: translateY(-14px); }
  66% { content: url('landing.png'); transform: translateY(2px); }
  100% { content: url('ground.png'); transform: translateY(0); }
}

.agent-hopping {
  animation: hop-cycle 200ms ease-out;
}

Dust effect

Landing frame already has dust particles baked in. For extra polish, Bobby can add a CSS particle effect on landing that spawns 2-3 circles that expand and fade over 300ms.

Direction

These frames are facing FORWARD (toward camera / south). For east/west movement, flip the sprite with transform: scaleX(-1). For north movement, Bobby can either use these same frames (acceptable) or request back-facing variants (future).

Render Script

scripts/render-hop-frames.js

To regenerate:

node projects/steffen/scripts/render-hop-frames.js

JSON Sidecars

Every PNG has a matching JSON with:

  • Agent ID and signature color
  • Frame index (0, 1, 2) and frame name
  • Animation timing specs
  • Usage notes for Bobby
  • Tags for catalog search
